```{r}
rm(list = ls())

Octo_Field <- read_csv ("C:\\Users\\bwvma\\OneDrive - ucsc.edu\\One Drive Back Up\\R-Studio\\Octodata\\Midden and live abalone lengths and biomass by location and quality 2 2.csv")

Octo_Biomass_Calc <- read_csv ("C:\\Users\\bwvma\\OneDrive - ucsc.edu\\One Drive Back Up\\R-Studio\\Octodata\\Biomass formula calculator.csv")

Biomass_formula_data <- Octo_Biomass_Calc |> 
  select(length,`weight (g)`,`abalone #`)

Biomass_formula_data
```
```{r}
library("extrafont")

theme_set(
  theme_classic(base_size = 18.46, base_family = "Calibri")
)
```

```{r}
Calculating_Biomass_graph <- Biomass_formula_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x=length,
    y=`weight (g)`))+
 
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0,NA)
  ) +
  
  geom_smooth(
   method = lm,
   fullrange = TRUE,
   formula = y ~0+ x + I(x^2) + I(x^3),
   colour = "blue"
) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = length,
      y = 0.06858280385283284374953 * length^3 + 0.22034755586896595525026 * length^2 + 0.20579305903708586256151 * length),
    colour = "red"
    )


Calculating_Biomass_graph

model_cubic <- lm(`weight (g)` ~ 0 + length + I(length^2) + I(length^3),
            data = Biomass_formula_data)

model_logisitic <- lm(log(`weight (g)`) ~ 0 + length + I(length^2) + I(length^3),
            data = Biomass_formula_data)

model_quadratic <- lm(`weight (g)` ~ length + I(length^2),
         data = Biomass_formula_data)

model_linear <- lm(`weight (g)` ~ length,
         data = Biomass_formula_data)


format(model_cubic$coefficients, digits = 22, scientific = FALSE)

summary(model_cubic)$r.squared
summary(model_quadratic)$r.squared
summary(model_linear)$r.squared

BIC(model_cubic)
BIC(model_quadratic)
BIC(model_linear)




ggsave(Calculating_Biomass_graph, filename="Calculating_Biomass_Formula_Graph.png",dpi=600, height=7, width=10)
  
# y = 0.06858280385283284374953 * length^3 + 0.22034755586896595525026 * length^2 + 0.20579305903708586256151 * length
```
```{r}

Corrected_Biomass_data_set <- Octo_Field |> 
  select(`Shell Length`,Location) |> 
  mutate(Biomass = 0.06858280385283284374953 * `Shell Length`^3 + 0.22034755586896595525026 * `Shell Length`^2 + 0.20579305903708586256151 * `Shell Length`) |> 
  
  arrange(Biomass)

Corrected_Biomass_graph <- Corrected_Biomass_data_set |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x=`Shell Length`,
    y=Biomass))+
 
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0,NA)
  ) +
  
  geom_smooth(
   method = lm,
   fullrange = TRUE,
   formula = y ~0+ x + I(x^2) + I(x^3),
   colour = "blue"
)

Corrected_Biomass_data_set
Corrected_Biomass_graph
```


```{r}
Graph_Top <- Corrected_Biomass_data_set |>
  filter(Location == "Alive") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Biomass)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = ..count.. / sum(..count..)),
    bins = 13, # Number of bars
    fill = "#0072B2",
    color = "white",
    boundary = 0
  ) +
  
   geom_text(x = -0.75, y = .30, label = "(a)") +
  
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL, 
    title = "Live Abalone Population"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,30))

Graph_Top
```


```{r}
Graph_Middle <- Corrected_Biomass_data_set |>
```

```{r}
        Corrected_Biomass_data_set$Biomass[Corrected_Biomass_data_set$Location == "Poor Midden"])
```
